metadata.title: Binaries migrating in a gaseous disk: Where are the Galactic center binaries?

notes: No eligible stars. The paper does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate, nor does it follow up a previously identified unbound star. S0-2 is mentioned only as a mass analog (T:p2-b9), while S-stars, OB stars, and hypervelocity stars are discussed as populations or generic modeled outcomes rather than as individually identified unbound candidates.
